notes: GR4 makes identifier-3/4/5/6/7 stand for literal-1/2/3/4/5 in GR6-GR21: T1 uses CD items IA/IB/IC/IZ as identifier-3 (LEADING, ALL) and identifier-4 (AFTER/BEFORE); T2 IB as identifier-3 and ISTAR as identifier-5 in format 3 (01 AA*AACAADA); R1/R2 IA/IZ/ISTAR as identifier-3/5 under FIRST, CHARACTERS, LEADING, ALL and IB/IC/ID as identifier-4; R1 S4 I6 'ABC'/I7 'xyz' as identifier-6/7 (AFTER INITIAL ID turns only the last A into x: AABAACAADx). Every value equals the result the same statement gives with the literals in place. Run at --std 2002 on the pinned dc1f2dcce8 build matched.
